title: append_decision.ps1 corrupts non-ASCII characters on append: D-031's entry text contains 5 mojibake sequences (a real Unicode em-dash, UTF-8 bytes E2 80 94, double-encoded to C3 A2 E2 82 AC E2 80 9D) that do not exist anywhere in docs/DECISIONS.md at base a6e30c6 (0 occurrences) and appear only in the newly-appended D-031 entry (5 occurrences) -- verified byte-for-byte via `git show a6e30c6:docs/DECISIONS.md` vs HEAD. Root cause: append_decision.ps1's `Get-Content -LiteralPath $EntryFile -Raw` (no -Encoding argument) reads the maker's UTF-8(no-BOM) entry file using PowerShell 5.1's default ANSI/CP1252 codepage, misinterpreting the em-dash's 3 UTF-8 bytes as 3 separate CP1252 characters, which [System.IO.File]::AppendAllText then correctly re-encodes as UTF-8 -- producing permanent double-encoded corruption in an append-only file this project treats as immutable ground truth. Ironic given D-030 (the immediately preceding entry) is entirely about eliminating non-ASCII encoding ambiguity from a different reader.
evidence: python3 byte count: base a6e30c6 docs/DECISIONS.md has 0 occurrences of the byte sequence C3 A2 E2 82 AC; HEAD has 5, all inside the D-031 entry (e.g. the text reads 'to `31` <mojibake> same mechanism' where a plain em-dash was intended). append_decision.ps1's Get-Content -LiteralPath $EntryFile -Raw call has no -Encoding argument; the append write at the bottom of the script correctly uses New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false), so the corruption is introduced only on the read side.
fix_direction: Add -Encoding UTF8 (or -Encoding UTF8NoBOM on PS 7+) to append_decision.ps1's Get-Content -LiteralPath $EntryFile -Raw call; add a fixture asserting an em-dash/non-ASCII character in the entry file round-trips byte-identical through the script. D-031's own already-appended text cannot be edited (append-only) -- a future entry may add a corrective footnote if the garbled text is ever confusing to a reader, but that is optional since the meaning is still recoverable from context.
checker_note: Not this unit's own code (u2-source-watcher never touches append_decision.ps1); filed against the shared Lab Protocol tooling. Does not block this unit's PASS -- no functional/security/tenancy impact, project's own severity gate (project CLAUDE.md) rates medium as ledger-entry-only, not a blocker.
